prompt: Sort the invented features. These are practice features, not any product's list.

buckets.label: Control plane
buckets.hint: What is the model told, and which instruction wins?

buckets.label: Context & memory
buckets.hint: What is on the desk this call, and what is saved?

buckets.label: Loop & state
buckets.hint: What happens next, what do we carry, when do we stop?

buckets.label: Errors & recovery
buckets.hint: When something fails, how do we continue without spinning?

buckets.label: Tools
buckets.hint: What can the model do, and is each tool easy to use?

buckets.label: Permissions & sandbox
buckets.hint: Which actions are allowed, and how bad can a mistake get?

buckets.label: Verification & evals
buckets.hint: How do we know it's really done, and did the change help?

buckets.label: Observability
buckets.hint: What exactly happened, and where did time and money go?

items.text: A turn limit and a cost limit stop a run.
items.why: The loop holds its own brakes. The model does not decide when the run is too long.

items.text: A summary replaces the oldest turns when the window fills.
items.why: What the model sees is the context. Choosing what stays is the context wire.

items.text: A rule refuses a delete outside the project folder.
items.why: The harness refuses the action before it runs.

items.text: A failed tool call is returned as an error the model can read.
items.why: The error is returned as a result. Retrying it is a separate decision.

items.text: The run does not say done until a test passes.
items.why: The done claim is checked before it is trusted.

items.text: Every turn is written to a log with its cost.
items.why: The log is what lets you see where a run spent its money.
